story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_100_10:
You want to find a reason to be strong,
so you came to me?
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_200_10: Yeah. You lost to Red in an official match...
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_300_10:
but that motivated you to bounce back,
and you and your partner won the rematch.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_400_10:
You and Charizard looked like you had
a blast battling Red!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_500_10:
That battle was on another level. It left an
impression on us!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_600_10:
Thanks! I remember that match with
Red well!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_700_10:
And I understand how you feel. If you have
questions, I’ll answer as best as I can!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_900_10:
Then let’s get right to it! First question:
Why do you battle, Leon?
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_1000_10:
Well...part of me wants to meet my
audience’s expectations.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_1100_10:
But more than anything, Pokémon battles are
just so fun! I can’t get enough!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_1700_10:
Back in Alola, I battled for only one reason:
to protect what I cherished.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_1800_10:
I didn’t have the leisure to enjoy battles.
I was too busy training, hoping to get
stronger.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_1900_10:
But on Pasio, I’ve had many different
experiences.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_2000_10: Now, I can say I enjoy Pokémon battles.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_2200_10:
In that case, enjoy battles with your partner
from the bottom of your heart!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_2400_10: Now I’ve got a question for you, Hau.
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_2500_10: Why do YOU want to get stronger?
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_2600_10:
Huh? Well...’cause I wanna enjoy Pokémon
battles, just like you!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_2800_10:
There’s nothing more exciting than clashing
head-on in an all-out, serious battle!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_3000_10: Sure, it’s fine to enjoy battling...
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_3200_10:
He’s just using that as an excuse not to try
hard because he can’t beat the kahuna.
’Cause he can’t beat Hala when he’s serious!
story_arceus_11_02000/2401_1001_3600_10:
We should all burn with passion! Ignite the
fire in your heart and let it shine!
